deviations: The source choose_stage is a recommendation and has no persisted declaration. This service adds explicit registration and keeps recommendation separate; the silent overwrite is newly planted, not a claim the original has a downgrade state machine.

Active-session distinct-user telemetry is an exercise extension for observable boundaries. It decreases on departures; exposed_users in drift is cumulative distinct admitted/exposed audience and never inferred from current active sessions. A rotating large audience cannot evade the pilot cap.

Missing-controls versus present evidence, exact inclusive deadline, ordered drift labels and release policy are explicit deterministic organization contracts drawn from stage responsibilities. No stage universal quality order is introduced; pilot production data is legitimate.

Snapshot decode, recommendation, marker normalization, EpisodeGate, syslog-style line encoding and necessary path/schema helpers are supplied correct. Candidate work does not repeat once-per-key dedup, syslog PRI/escaping or a general shortest-slice algorithm.

Component requirements are per necessary edge with explicit owner/control/allowed authority facts, not every dependency being production and not claim/receipt kind matching. Optional isolated experiments are excluded. Fake release controls only a subsequent local step, not a write already observed.

The supplied dependency schema helper uses iterative cycle validation so finite1100-node chains work without changing the interpreter recursion limit. Necessary-cycle detection remains global; this is not a planted candidate algorithm task.
